tfr: Une marche de 10 minutes après le déjeuner
d: Moves lunch along and clears the afternoon slump.

tfr: Marche du soir
d: Movement after dinner — the strongest gentle lever on sleep.

t: A glass of water before coffee
tfr: Un verre d’eau avant le café
d: Start hydrated — the coffee lands softer.

tfr: Des protéines au petit-déjeuner
d: Eggs, skyr, leftovers — anything. Steadier energy before 11:00.

tfr: Des légumes sur la moitié de l’assiette
d: One plate a day where vegetables win the territory.

tfr: Cuisine fermée après 21 h
d: A closing time beats willpower.
flag: A practitioner may want this off for members with a history of disordered eating.

tfr: Même heure de coucher en semaine
d: The body loves a rhythm more than a number.

tfr: Pas de caféine après 14 h
d: The afternoon cup steals from the night.

tfr: Écrans éteints 30 minutes avant le coucher
d: Give the mind a runway.

tfr: Lumières tamisées après 21 h
d: Darkness is a signal, not an absence.

t: Morning light within an hour of waking
tfr: Lumière du matin dans l’heure qui suit le réveil
d: The night is built in the morning.
why: Outdoor light, short, never staring at the sun.

t: Two columns: worries and what you control
tfr: Deux colonnes : soucis et ce qui dépend de vous
d: On one sheet, list what worries you on the left and what you can actually act on today on the right.

t: Social media, about an hour a day
tfr: Réseaux sociaux, environ une heure par jour
d: Keep social media to about an hour today, and before each scroll, ask yourself why you are opening it.

tfr: Une gratitude qu’il faut chercher
d: Spend a few minutes finding one thing you are grateful for that you would usually take for granted.

t: Five minutes alone, with no input
tfr: Cinq minutes pour vous, sans écran ni personne
d: Take five minutes on your own, away from devices and other people, to hear your own thoughts.

tfr: Une marche d’un bon pas, 30 minutes
d: Thirty minutes of walking at a brisk pace, outdoors when you can.
why: Walking; the gentle version starts shorter.

t: Walk five minutes every half hour
tfr: Cinq minutes de marche toutes les demi-heures
d: For every 30 minutes sitting or standing still, get up and walk for at least five.

t: Seated calf raises under the desk
tfr: Montées de talons assis, sous le bureau
d: Stuck in a chair? Lift and lower your heels again and again to keep your calves working.

tfr: Séance de force : jambes
d: About an hour of short, hard sets for the front and back of the thighs and the calves.
why: An hour of hard sets close to failure: the practitioner checks heart, blood pressure and joints and sets the load.

tfr: Séance de force : poitrine, dos, tronc
d: About an hour of short, hard sets for the chest, the back and the core.
why: An hour of hard sets close to failure: the practitioner checks heart, blood pressure and joints and sets the load.

tfr: Séance de force : épaules et bras
d: About an hour of short, hard sets for the shoulders, biceps, triceps and core.
why: An hour of hard sets close to failure: the practitioner checks heart, blood pressure and joints and sets the load.

tfr: Cardio long et tranquille : 45 à 75 minutes
d: One long, steady session at a pace where you can just barely hold a conversation.
why: Long sessions; beginners start at 15–20 minutes, so the practitioner sets the starting point.

tfr: Cardio soutenu : 25 à 30 minutes
d: After an easy warm-up, 25–30 minutes at a pace that has you breathing hard but not gasping.
why: Sustained hard effort: needs a cardiovascular check first.

tfr: Intervalles : 30 secondes fort, 60 tranquille
d: After a warm-up, 6–12 rounds of 30 seconds near all-out and 60 seconds easy.
why: Near all-out effort: needs a cardiovascular check first.

tfr: Routine de mobilité, dix minutes
d: A short sequence for hips, back, shoulders and wrists — at the end of a workout or any time of day.
why: The lead clinician chose 'only if your practice has cleared you' for this card.
flag: Low intensity: could move to free if the clearance line comes off.

t: Five minutes sitting with your breath
tfr: Cinq minutes avec votre souffle
d: Set a timer for five minutes, sit still and keep your attention on your breathing.
flag: Some members with trauma find breath focus hard; the practitioner can switch it off for them.

t: A two-hour focus block, then a break
tfr: Deux heures concentrées, puis une pause
d: Work or study for one timed two-hour block, then stop for a short break.

tfr: Toute votre attention à chaque répétition
d: During today’s workout, put all your attention on each repetition — or let your mind go quiet on a run.
why: Attention cue during a workout the member already does.

t: A cold shower, one to three minutes
tfr: Une douche froide, une à trois minutes
d: Cold water for 1 to 3 minutes, staying calm through the urge to get out — never beyond 5 minutes.
why: Cold shock raises heart rate and blood pressure: needs screening first.

tfr: Respiration tonique avant un travail concentré
d: Rounds of 10 to 20 deep, vigorous breaths in through the nose for 3 to 5 minutes, sitting down and away from water, to feel more alert before a task.
why: Fast deep breathing can cause dizziness and tingling: needs screening first.

t: The double-inhale sigh, up to three times
tfr: Le soupir à double inspiration, jusqu’à trois fois
d: When stress hits, two breaths in through the nose and one long breath out through the mouth — often one is enough.
why: A few seconds of slow breathing.

tfr: Cinq minutes de soupirs cycliques
d: Five calm minutes of double breaths in and long breaths out, on an ordinary day — not only when stress hits.

tfr: Dix respirations attentives au réveil
d: Before the day starts, count ten breaths with your attention resting in one place.

t: Five minutes of 40 Hz beats before focus
tfr: Battements à 40 Hz, cinq minutes avant le travail
d: Before a work or study session, listen to 40 Hz binaural beats through headphones for 5 minutes.
why: Kept for members: an extra on the focus track, and its evidence is thin. Listening to audio.
flag: The record cites no study. Maybe keep it out of autopilot packs until reviewed.

tfr: Respirer par le nez, avec le ventre
d: Through the day, check that you breathe through your nose, with your belly rising as you breathe in.

t: Phone in another room while you focus
tfr: Téléphone dans une autre pièce pour vous concentrer
d: For your next block of focused work, put your phone in a different room — not just face down on the desk.

t: Wish, outcome, obstacle, plan — on paper
tfr: Souhait, résultat, obstacle, plan — par écrit
d: Take ten minutes to write down one goal, how reaching it would feel, what will get in the way, and your plan for each obstacle.

tfr: Exercez-vous juste au-delà de votre niveau
d: When you practise a skill, set the difficulty so that some of your attempts fail — mistakes are part of the work.
why: Kept for members: with the next two, a 'learn faster' mini pack. Learning method.

tfr: De courtes pauses quand vous vous exercez
d: During a practice session, add brief pauses between attempts: a few seconds for a physical skill, a few minutes for a mental one.
why: Kept for members: part of the 'learn faster' mini pack. Learning method.

tfr: Testez-vous après avoir appris
d: After a study or practice session, spend 1 to 5 minutes checking what you remember and understand.
why: Kept for members: part of the 'learn faster' mini pack. Learning method.

t: Bring your thoughts back to here
tfr: Ramenez vos pensées ici et maintenant
d: A few times today, check whether your thoughts are where you are — and if not, gently bring them back.
flag: The record says clinical depression needs professional follow-up: the card does not replace that.

t: The same small ritual at each switch
tfr: Le même petit rituel à chaque transition
d: Choose one short physical gesture and repeat it every time you move from one task or role to the next.

tfr: Le premier café 30 minutes après le lever
d: Wait 30 minutes after waking before your first coffee or tea.
why: Timing of a drink the member already has.

tfr: Un vrai repas après l’entraînement
d: Within about three hours of a training session, a meal with starchy foods or fruit and a good protein.

t: Most of your water in the first ten hours
tfr: Boire surtout pendant les dix premières heures
d: Front-load your water: start on waking, then drink about every hour through the first ten hours of your day.
flag: The steps give about 2.4 L: not for members on a fluid restriction (heart, kidney). A practitioner should switch it off for them, or make the card prescription-only.

tfr: Un repas fait d’aliments bruts
d: Build one meal today from foods with a single ingredient, cooked and seasoned by you.

tfr: Les protéines d’abord, puis le reste
d: At your main meal, eat the protein first, then the starch, then the vegetables.
flag: Same eating-history caution as 'Kitchen closed after 21:00'.

tfr: Cuisiner à l’huile d’olive
d: Make olive oil your everyday cooking fat, with avocado oil for high heat.

t: Fermented foods, two to four a day
tfr: Des aliments fermentés, deux à quatre par jour
d: Add a serving of a chilled, low-sugar fermented food to your meals — two to four servings over the day.
why: Kept for members: a refinement once the nutrition basics hold. Food choice.
flag: Members with histamine intolerance or digestive conditions may react: practitioner to judge.

t: Ten minutes of guided deep rest
tfr: Dix minutes de repos profond guidé
d: Lie down and follow a 10-minute guided deep-rest recording: long breaths out, attention moving through the body.

t: Midday sun on your skin, 20–30 minutes
tfr: Soleil de midi sur la peau, 20 à 30 minutes
d: Spend 20 to 30 minutes outdoors in daylight with some skin uncovered — and never let your skin burn.
why: Sun on bare skin: depends on skin history and on medication that makes skin sun-sensitive.

t: One hour for a hobby this week
tfr: Une heure pour un loisir cette semaine
d: Give one hour this week to a hobby that has nothing to do with work or your usual routine.
why: Kept for members: a weekly extra. Leisure time.

tfr: Lumière de fin d’après-midi
d: Spend at least 10–15 minutes outdoors in the late-afternoon light, facing the setting sun if you can.
why: Kept for members: the morning-light card already carries the trial. Outdoor light.

tfr: Même heure de lever, week-end compris
d: Get up within 30 minutes of the same time every morning, weekends included.

tfr: Une promenade imaginaire au coucher
d: Busy mind in bed? Walk a familiar route in your head instead of chasing your thoughts.

tfr: Mouvements lents des yeux au coucher
d: In bed with your eyes closed, move your eyes slowly in each direction, then take one big breath in and a long breath out.
why: Eye movements and one long breath out.

t: A cool bedroom for the night
tfr: Une chambre fraîche pour la nuit
d: Keep the bedroom cool, between 65 and 68°F (18.3–20°C), and give your hands and feet room to cool down.

tfr: Une douche chaude avant le coucher
d: Take a hot shower or bath before bed, then let your body cool off in a cool bedroom.
flag: A practitioner may switch it off for members who faint easily or have low blood pressure.

t: Hard workouts end 3–4 hours before bed
tfr: Effort intense fini 3 à 4 h avant le coucher
d: Plan intense workouts so they end 3–4 hours or more before you go to sleep.

tfr: Une courte sieste, 15 à 20 minutes
d: In the early to mid-afternoon, nap for 15–20 minutes with an alarm set.
why: Naps can make insomnia worse: the practitioner decides whether it fits this member's sleep plan.

t: No alcohol in the eight hours before bed
tfr: Pas d’alcool huit heures avant le coucher
d: Keep the 8 hours before bed alcohol-free, and never use a drink to help you fall asleep.
why: Touches alcohol use: a member who depends on alcohol needs a practitioner's plan, not an app card.
flag: The idea itself is safe: could go free with softer wording.

tfr: Un vrai déjeuner avec quelqu’un
d: Once in the week, lunch is company, not a screen.

tfr: Cinq minutes de journal
d: Unfiltered, for nobody else.

tfr: Nommez l’émotion, une fois
d: One moment a day: what is this feeling called?

t: One message to someone you like
tfr: Un message à quelqu’un que vous appréciez
d: Thirty seconds of connection, sent.

tfr: Dites non à une chose
d: One small no that protects the day.

tfr: Trois bonnes choses ce soir
d: Small ones count double.

tfr: Étirements du matin, cinq minutes
d: Wake the body before the day claims it.

tfr: Une série de pompes
d: Whatever number feels doable — form over count.
why: One set, the member picks the number.

tfr: Les escaliers plutôt que l’ascenseur
d: Free training hidden in the day.

tfr: Dix assis-debout
d: From a chair, no equipment — legs carry everything else.

tfr: Une pause de deux minutes entre deux tâches
d: Stand up, look far away, breathe once.

tfr: Respiration carrée, 4×4
d: In four, hold four, out four, hold four — four rounds.

tfr: Cinq minutes de lumière du jour
d: Light anchors the body clock — mornings work best.
flag: Near-duplicate of 'Five minutes outside in daylight': merge?

tfr: Un café sans téléphone
d: One warm drink a day with nothing else in your hands.

tfr: Une seule tâche pendant la première heure de travail
d: One thing, done properly, before the noise starts.

tfr: Trois respirations lentes avant les repas
d: Tells the body "we're safe" — meals land better.

tfr: Un fruit à portée de main
d: When the dip hits, the easy option is already in your hand.

tfr: Les cinq premières bouchées, lentement
d: The first five bites set the pace for the whole meal.

tfr: Une balade de 20 minutes dans la nature
d: Green time on the weekend — no pace, no goal.

t: A real pause at lunch, no screens
tfr: Une vraie pause à midi, sans écrans
d: Twenty minutes where nothing is asked of you.

tfr: Cinq minutes dehors, à la lumière du jour
d: The cheapest recharge there is.
flag: Near-duplicate of 'Five minutes of daylight': merge?

t: Legs up the wall, five minutes
tfr: Jambes au mur, cinq minutes
d: Let the system idle before the evening.

tfr: Un créneau sans travail le soir
d: An hour where work cannot reach you.

t: Shoulders down, jaw loose — three times
tfr: Épaules basses, mâchoire relâchée — trois fois
d: The two places the day hides.

tfr: La liste de demain avant le coucher
d: Park the open loops on paper.
